title: Xi says Taiwan 'reunification' must happen as history cannot be stopped
detail: Xi Jinping stated that Taiwan 'reunification' must happen and that the course of history cannot be stopped, per a headline syndicated via Google News. The originating outlet and full context are not identified in the feed, so the wording is unconfirmed pending a primary transcript.

title: G7 Foreign Ministers say China's actions east of Taiwan threaten stability
detail: G7 Foreign Ministers said China's actions east of Taiwan threaten regional stability, according to The Hindu.
